key_terms.الْأَمَانَةِ: trust; something entrusted that must be safeguarded
key_terms.اَلْمَجَالِسُ: gatherings or assemblies where people sit together

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Gatherings are based on trust" mean?
ai.summary: This concise hadith teaches that what is spoken and heard in gatherings is held in trust and should not be disclosed improperly. It establishes an ethical norm of discretion, respect, and protection of others’ words within social settings.
